request.text: Before we leave the hotel, check whether rain is expected near the Louvre this evening. Remind me at 3:30 this afternoon to start back, and when you report the forecast, look at me for four seconds. Stay where you are—don't walk.

responsibilities.outcome: Obtain this evening's weather near the Louvre and report whether rain is expected.
Create a reminder for 3:30 this afternoon to start back.
Look at the user for four seconds while reporting the returned forecast, without walking.

new_goals.description: Check whether rain is expected near the Louvre this evening and report the result.
new_goals.source_text: Before we leave the hotel, check whether rain is expected near the Louvre this evening.
constraints: Use the area near the Louvre, today, and the evening period.
Ground the rain report in the returned weather result.
success_criteria: The user receives a weather-grounded statement about expected rain near the Louvre this evening.

new_goals.description: Set a 3:30-this-afternoon reminder to start back.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 3:30 this afternoon to start back.
constraints: Use 3:30 this afternoon as the reminder trigger.
Preserve start back as the reminder purpose.
success_criteria: The requested return reminder is created with the specified trigger.

new_goals.description: Look at the user for four seconds while delivering the forecast report, without changing position.
new_goals.source_text: When you report the forecast, look at me for four seconds. Stay where you are—don't walk.
constraints: The look target is the user and the duration is four seconds.
Coordinate the look with the forecast report.
Do not walk or change position.
success_criteria: A four-second look at the user accompanies the forecast report without forward movement.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request contains a weather-and-report Goal, an independent reminder Goal, and a report-coordinated attention Goal with an explicit no-walking constraint.

semantic_facts: The plan must preserve all three Goals: obtain and report the Louvre-area evening rain forecast, create the 3:30 return reminder, and coordinate a four-second look at the user with the grounded forecast report.
The reminder may be handled independently; the forecast report and look action must wait for the lookup result, and the explicit stay-in-place constraint forbids walking.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents the forecast, claims any capability result prematurely, walks despite the prohibition, looks at an unspecified person, changes the four-second duration, or collapses the attention Goal into generic response wording.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner ignores a negative movement constraint when coordinating an embodied attention action with speech.
The planner loses the dependency between weather evidence and the coordinated report while serializing the independent reminder unnecessarily.
